summary: A +2 greataxe that adds 1d6 Fire to hits, grants Heat, and can use Hellflame Cleave.

fields.Thermodynamo: Dealing damage with the axe grants 2 turns of Heat. Heat can stack to 7 turns, deals 1d4 Fire to you each turn, and can be spent to add 1 Fire damage per remaining turn to your next Fire damage.
fields.Hellflame Cleave: Action once per Short Rest. Deal weapon damage as Fire plus 2d6 Fire in a 10 ft cone. Dexterity save against spell save DC for half. Leaves Hellfire for 2 turns. The surface can apply Roiling Hellfire even on a successful save.
fields.Limits: Does not bypass Fire resistance or immunity despite the tooltip. Uses no attack roll and cannot be used while Raging. The axe cannot be dipped.
fields.Base value: 960 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
